modeFlag: explicit CLI mode; no separate environment flag

cycleMeaning.proposalIDs: frozen lookup drafts from consumed history plus current pending
cycleMeaning.provisionalIDs: actual sampled next IDs through first mismatch or stop inclusive
cycleMeaning.consumedInputs: pending plus matched drafts, not correction/bonus
cycleMeaning.verifiedInputs: actual branch inputs evaluated; includes rejected suffix
cycleMeaning.wall: begin/cycle verification/sampling/replay/finish; excludes cycle hash formatting
cycleMeaning.decodeWall: includes cycle hash/counter formatting, all loop/transaction/sampler/recovery work

finalState.linearStateSHA256: actual convolution/recurrent Float bitPattern bytes by sorted layer
finalState.committedKeysSHA256: validKV Float bitPattern bytes by sorted layer
finalState.committedValuesSHA256: validKV Float bitPattern bytes by sorted layer

acceptedChain.routeEncoding: sorted position/layer, JSONEncoder.sortedKeys per route plus newline, IDs and UInt32 weightbits
acceptedChain.rawEncoding: consumed input order; little-endian host Float.bitPattern bytes; excludes rejected suffix

goldenPolicy: raw capture hash fixed; goldenIDs are assertion only after complete generation
limits: 29 sampled IDs includes terminalEOS; EOS remains pending, never consumed
OFF one turn; ON per-cycle turns; no outer conversation integration
CPU is process-level evidence, not additive timing
Same source checks and sampler boundary as original pair diagnostic
